about: One entry per package under systems/. Paths are relative to the repository root. Every package has README.md (the entry) and style-guide.html at its top level; docs/PACKAGE.md describes what sits underneath. tags are for search and filtering. preview names the gallery cover screenshot, the product's `icon.png` and the token paths the catalog site resolves into swatches and fonts, so every value shown traces back to tokens. An empty widths list means the package README is the place to look. platform is web, mobile or desktop: the scorecard grades the package against that platform's wording of each criterion (scorecard/criteria.json). Run `make check` after editing. designMd, where present, overrides the token path prefixes `make design-md` reads for a package's DESIGN.md (colors, typography, rounded, spacing); the defaults are the swatches' semantic set and core.typography, core.radius, core.spacing or core.space. capture records how the package's extraction ran: harness and model (from the capture commits' Co-Authored-By trailer), version (the product version captured, when it was recorded), route (dom-snapshot, iphone-mirroring, electron-cdp, web-inspector, native-pixels, stylesheets, headless or public-web), pr (the pull request that added the package; imported packages name their capture PR under source instead), and durationMin (how long the capture took; null where it was never recorded - docs/CAPTURE.md asks new captures to fill it).
